title: Highly recommend
text: We had such a great time on this tour! Our tour guide Alastair was amazing! He was well informed, personable and so much fun! We went to some great places, had great food and wine and were very impressed! Highly recommend!!!
author: debbiekK2958QH

title: Alastair showed us a good time!!

author: Debra_K

title: Great start to a Barcelona visit.
text:
Our guide Alasdair met us promptly at arranged point. He was extremely knowledgeable about the city and the customs. Each stop allowed sufficient time for a drink and a sample of food. Although probably not as good for tour company, we were delighted to be only ones in group. Each restaurant was family run and we were served promptly and cheerfully.
This was a great initiation to Barcelona. 
Alasdair was a great guide for us as he is a native English speaker. He will do well for others as he speaks multiple languages.
author: margaretbT1365YH

title: Barcelona Must Do!
text: This was our second time with this food tour; that’s how special it is!  You experience neighborhood bars that have an authentic feel along with great food, drinks, and insight into local culture. Our guide was terrific. You know he really enjoys sharing the experience. If you enjoy food tours, don’t miss this one!
author: nankar

title: Best Food Tour EVER
text:
Moises was the absolute best. Every recommendation was spot on and it was hands down the best food tour of our trip.

This is a must do for anyone visiting Barcelona.
author: lexileonard

title: Amazing guide! Great experience
text: I had a really wonderful time on this! The guide takes everyones preferences and dietary restrictions into account - one of our members didn’t care for alcohol, so he found him interesting n/a drink options, and my friend doesn’t eat pork, so he found her cool substitutes as well. The food was incredible but beyond that we learned a little about each establishment and the cultural norms of Barcelona. My friend and I still talk about this and would do it again. Would recommend!
author: angelagN568KZ

title: Amazing Tour
text: It was an amazing experience! Alastair was the best guide. He took us to great places where we had amazing food and drinks. He was so knowledgeable and friendly it felt like we were with a friend! Highly recommend this tour!
author: Concetta_P

title: Fun Tapas Tour
text: The tour with Alasdair was phenomenal! He was very knowledgeable about the history of the area we were touring and his food recommendations were spot on! Highly recommend booking this tour - did it as a solo traveler and met some great people!
